{"interpretation": "Brighten the Synths during Verse 2 (bars 33–48) with a gentle high-shelf lift, keeping the top end smooth rather than harsh.", "variants": [{"label":"Gentle air lift","description":"Adds a mild EQ high boost on Synths, automated across Verse 2 only, for a smooth brightness.","steps":[{"kind":"ops","ops":[{"op":"fx.add","scope":{"kind":"track","trackId":"trk_synths"},"fx":{"id":"fx_bright1","type":"eq3","params":{},"bypass":false}},{"op":"automation.set","scope":{"kind":"lane","sectionId":"sec_verse2","trackId":"trk_synths"},"target":"fx:fx_bright1/highDb","points":[{"tick":0,"value":0,"curve":"linear"},{"tick":15360,"value":3,"curve":"linear"}]}]}]},{"label":"Brighter with soft top","description":"Stronger high-band lift on Synths in Verse 2, with a gentle saturation tone to keep it from sounding harsh.","steps":[{"kind":"ops","ops":[{"op":"fx.add","scope":{"kind":"track","trackId":"trk_synths"},"fx":{"id":"fx_bright2","type":"eq3","params":{},"bypass":false}},{"op":"automation.set","scope":{"kind":"lane","sectionId":"sec_verse2","trackId":"trk_synths"},"target":"fx:fx_bright2/highDb","points":[{"tick":0,"value":0,"curve":"linear"},{"tick":15360,"value":6,"curve":"linear"}]}]}]}]}

{"interpretation": "Add more spatial reverb to the Texture track during the Intro section only, fading in to a fuller wash.", "variants": [{"label":"Subtle room","description":"Adds a reverb on Texture, mix rising gently across the Intro.","steps":[{"kind":"ops","ops":[{"op":"fx.add","scope":{"kind":"track","trackId":"trk_texture"},"fx":{"id":"fx_space1","type":"reverb","params":{"mix":0},"bypass":false}},{"op":"automation.set","scope":{"kind":"lane","sectionId":"sec_intro","trackId":"trk_texture"},"target":"fx:fx_space1/mix","points":[{"tick":0,"value":0.05,"curve":"linear"},{"tick":15360,"value":0.25,"curve":"linear"}]}]}]},{"label":"Wide hall","description":"Adds a larger, longer reverb on Texture, mix swelling across the Intro.","steps":[{"kind":"ops","ops":[{"op":"fx.add","scope":{"kind":"track","trackId":"trk_texture"},"fx":{"id":"fx_space2","type":"reverb","params":{"mix":0,"size":0.8,"decaySec":5},"bypass":false}},{"op":"automation.set","scope":{"kind":"lane","sectionId":"sec_intro","trackId":"trk_texture"},"target":"fx:fx_space2/mix","points":[{"tick":0,"value":0.1,"curve":"linear"},{"tick":15360,"value":0.45,"curve":"linear"}]}]}]}]}

{"interpretation": "Make the whole song warmer by adding gentle low-mid warmth and softening the top end across the mix, leaving the bridge untouched.", "variants": [{"label":"Subtle warmth","description":"Light macro warmth across the whole song, with gentle saturation on synths and keys.","scope":"song","steps":[{"kind":"ops","ops":[{"op":"fx.add","scope":{"kind":"track","trackId":"trk_synths"},"fx":{"id":"fx_synthsWarm","type":"saturation","params":{"drive":0.2,"tone":-0.2,"mix":0.4},"bypass":false}},{"op":"fx.add","scope":{"kind":"track","trackId":"trk_keys"},"fx":{"id":"fx_keysWarm","type":"saturation","params":{"drive":0.15,"tone":-0.2,"mix":0.3},"bypass":false}}]}]},{"label":"Full warm tone","description":"Stronger warmth: macro lift plus low-mid EQ bump and softened highs on the bass and synths.","scope":"song","steps":[{"kind":"ops","ops":[{"op":"fx.add","scope":{"kind":"track","trackId":"trk_bass"},"fx":{"id":"fx_bassWarmEq","type":"eq3","params":{"lowDb":3,"midDb":1,"highDb":-2},"bypass":false}},{"op":"fx.add","scope":{"kind":"track","trackId":"trk_synths"},"fx":{"id":"fx_synthsWarmEq","type":"eq3","params":{"lowDb":1,"midDb":1,"highDb":-3,"highHz":6000},"bypass":false}},{"op":"fx.add","scope":{"kind":"track","trackId":"trk_synths"},"fx":{"id":"fx_synthsSat","type":"saturation","params":{"drive":0.35,"tone":-0.3,"mix":0.5},"bypass":false}}]}]}]}

{"interpretation": "Make the Keys warmer within the verse (bars 5–12) by adding a gentle saturation and a slight low-mid lift, shaped only over that section.", "variants": [{"label":"Subtle warmth","description":"Light tape-style saturation on Keys in the verse only, with a gentle low-mid boost.","steps":[{"kind":"ops","ops":[{"op":"fx.add","scope":{"kind":"track","trackId":"trk_keys"},"fx":{"id":"fx_warm1","type":"saturation","params":{"drive":0,"tone":0,"mix":0},"bypass":false}},{"op":"automation.set","scope":{"kind":"lane","sectionId":"sec_b","trackId":"trk_keys"},"target":"fx:fx_warm1/drive","points":[{"tick":0,"value":0.15,"curve":"linear"},{"tick":15360,"value":0.15,"curve":"linear"}]},{"op":"automation.set","scope":{"kind":"lane","sectionId":"sec_b","trackId":"trk_keys"},"target":"fx:fx_warm1/mix","points":[{"tick":0,"value":0.35,"curve":"linear"},{"tick":15360,"value":0.35,"curve":"linear"}]}]}]},{"label":"Fuller warmth","description":"Stronger saturation and a low-mid lift on Keys, confined to the verse section.","steps":[{"kind":"ops","ops":[{"op":"fx.add","scope":{"kind":"track","trackId":"trk_keys"},"fx":{"id":"fx_warm2","type":"saturation","params":{"drive":0,"tone":-0.2,"mix":0},"bypass":false}},{"op":"automation.set","scope":{"kind":"lane","sectionId":"sec_b","trackId":"trk_keys"},"target":"fx:fx_warm2/drive","points":[{"tick":0,"value":0.35,"curve":"linear"},{"tick":15360,"value":0.35,"curve":"linear"}]},{"op":"automation.set","scope":{"kind":"lane","sectionId":"sec_b","trackId":"trk_keys"},"target":"fx:fx_warm2/mix","points":[{"tick":0,"value":0.6,"curve":"linear"},{"tick":15360,"value":0.6,"curve":"linear"}]}]}]}]}

{"interpretation": "Tighten the bass's low end within the focus region (Verse 1, bars 9–24) by adding a filter that gently rolls off sub rumble and cleans up low-end mud.", "variants": [{"label":"Gentle low cleanup","description":"Adds a filter on Bass in Verse 1 and sweeps cutoff slightly lower for a tighter low end.","steps":[{"kind":"ops","ops":[{"op":"fx.add","scope":{"kind":"track","trackId":"trk_bass"},"fx":{"id":"fx_bassfilt1","type":"filter","params":{},"bypass":false}},{"op":"automation.set","scope":{"kind":"lane","sectionId":"sec_verse1","trackId":"trk_bass"},"target":"fx:fx_bassfilt1/cutoffHz","points":[{"tick":0,"value":20000,"curve":"linear"},{"tick":15360,"value":250,"curve":"linear"}]}]}]},{"label":"Firm low tightening","description":"Adds an EQ on Bass in Verse 1 cutting low mud and rumble more decisively for a punchier bottom.","steps":[{"kind":"ops","ops":[{"op":"fx.add","scope":{"kind":"track","trackId":"trk_bass"},"fx":{"id":"fx_basseq1","type":"eq3","params":{},"bypass":false}},{"op":"automation.set","scope":{"kind":"lane","sectionId":"sec_verse1","trackId":"trk_bass"},"target":"fx:fx_basseq1/lowDb","points":[{"tick":0,"value":0,"curve":"linear"},{"tick":15360,"value":-6,"curve":"linear"}]}]}]}]}

{"interpretation": "Make the whole song feel bigger by adding width, space and a touch of limiting-friendly punch across the mix, leaving the locked bridge untouched.", "variants": [{"label":"Wide and roomy","description":"Widen synths and add reverb space to the keys and vocals for a larger stereo image.","scope":"song","steps":[{"kind":"ops","ops":[{"op":"fx.add","scope":{"kind":"track","trackId":"trk_synths"},"fx":{"id":"fx_synths_width","type":"width","params":{"width":1.3},"bypass":false}},{"op":"fx.add","scope":{"kind":"track","trackId":"trk_keys"},"fx":{"id":"fx_keys_verb","type":"reverb","params":{"size":0.7,"decaySec":3.5,"mix":0.25},"bypass":false}},{"op":"fx.add","scope":{"kind":"track","trackId":"trk_vox"},"fx":{"id":"fx_vox_verb","type":"reverb","params":{"size":0.6,"decaySec":2.5,"mix":0.18},"bypass":false}}]}]},{"label":"Punchy and loud","description":"Add transient attack to drums and a gentle bass compressor for a denser, forward low end.","scope":"song","steps":[{"kind":"ops","ops":[{"op":"fx.add","scope":{"kind":"track","trackId":"trk_drums"},"fx":{"id":"fx_drums_transient","type":"transient","params":{"attack":0.4,"sustain":0.2},"bypass":false}},{"op":"fx.add","scope":{"kind":"track","trackId":"trk_bass"},"fx":{"id":"fx_bass_comp","type":"compressor","params":{"thresholdDb":-16,"ratio":3,"makeupDb":2},"bypass":false}},{"op":"fx.add","scope":{"kind":"track","trackId":"trk_drums"},"fx":{"id":"fx_drums_sat","type":"saturation","params":{"drive":0.25,"mix":0.5},"bypass":false}}]}]}]}

{"interpretation": "Make the whole song feel bigger by widening the synths, adding reverb space to keys and vocals, and adding punch to drums and bass, leaving the locked bridge untouched.", "variants": [{"label":"Wide and roomy","description":"Widen synths and add reverb space to the keys and vocals for a larger stereo image.","scope":"song","steps":[{"kind":"ops","ops":[{"op":"fx.add","scope":{"kind":"track","trackId":"trk_synths"},"fx":{"id":"fx_synthswidth","type":"width","params":{"width":1.3},"bypass":false}},{"op":"fx.add","scope":{"kind":"track","trackId":"trk_keys"},"fx":{"id":"fx_keysverb","type":"reverb","params":{"size":0.7,"decaySec":3.5,"mix":0.25},"bypass":false}},{"op":"fx.add","scope":{"kind":"track","trackId":"trk_vox"},"fx":{"id":"fx_voxverb","type":"reverb","params":{"size":0.6,"decaySec":2.5,"mix":0.18},"bypass":false}}]}]},{"label":"Punchy and loud","description":"Add transient attack to drums and a gentle bass compressor for a denser, forward low end.","scope":"song","steps":[{"kind":"ops","ops":[{"op":"fx.add","scope":{"kind":"track","trackId":"trk_drums"},"fx":{"id":"fx_drumstransient","type":"transient","params":{"attack":0.4,"sustain":0.2},"bypass":false}},{"op":"fx.add","scope":{"kind":"track","trackId":"trk_bass"},"fx":{"id":"fx_basscomp","type":"compressor","params":{"thresholdDb":-16,"ratio":3,"makeupDb":2},"bypass":false}},{"op":"fx.add","scope":{"kind":"track","trackId":"trk_drums"},"fx":{"id":"fx_drumssat","type":"saturation","params":{"drive":0.25,"mix":0.5},"bypass":false}}]}]}]}

{"interpretation": "Lower the level of the whole song so it plays quieter, keeping the balance between tracks intact.", "variants": [{"label":"Quieter by 3 dB","description":"Drops all three track levels by 3 dB, preserving the existing mix balance.","scope":"song","steps":[{"kind":"ops","ops":[{"op":"track.update","trackId":"trk_drums","patch":{"gainDb":-3}},{"op":"track.update","trackId":"trk_bass","patch":{"gainDb":-3}},{"op":"track.update","trackId":"trk_keys","patch":{"gainDb":-3}}]}]},{"label":"Quieter by 6 dB","description":"Drops all three track levels by 6 dB for a clearly lower overall volume.","scope":"song","steps":[{"kind":"ops","ops":[{"op":"track.update","trackId":"trk_drums","patch":{"gainDb":-6}},{"op":"track.update","trackId":"trk_bass","patch":{"gainDb":-6}},{"op":"track.update","trackId":"trk_keys","patch":{"gainDb":-6}}]}]}]}

{"interpretation": "Remove the second verse section (sec_verse1 is the first verse; the second verse is sec_verse2, bars 33–48) and close the gap so later sections move up.", "variants": [{"label":"Remove verse 2","description":"Deletes the second verse (bars 33–48) and closes the gap so the rest of the song moves up.","scope":"song","steps":[{"kind":"ops","ops":[{"op":"section.remove","sectionId":"sec_verse2","closeGap":true}]}]}]}
